method: Expert estimates of behavioral fidelity, not objective test coverage. Scores may have ±5–10 percentage points or greater uncertainty. Only dated player confirmations qualify as in-game tests; static CI alone does not.

systems.title: City health and disease
systems.verification: Full health prototype compiled successfully in GitHub Actions; no in-game acceptance tests yet. Correct source building, trait, resource and feature values loaded from pinned EMM XML. Full side-by-side APK packaging pending.
systems.remainingDifferences: Population-based unhealthiness and source-derived direct building (+2 Aqueduct/+1 Herbalist/+3 Infirmary), Expansive (+3), available connected resources, freshwater (+2) and Forest/Jungle/Flood plains percentages now feed excess-Food penalty; old building Food proxies are canceled in patched engine. Provisional starting health 2; lacks source-accurate difficulty values, Civ IV city radius geometry, area/global/building-resource synergies, no-unhealthy-population effects, disease/Blight, detailed city UI, AI health planning and gameplay/save/load verification.
systems.updatedBy: First expanded EMM health engine milestone; pinned source audit and Android build
